params.body:
The bridge in #161 sent thumbnails of older photo versions through the app route to build the WebP on first request. On staging the detail page of a vehicle with 69 photos fired dozens of those builds at once (each reads the original from S3 and resizes), PHP-FPM ran out of workers and the page itself answered 504.

Now a photo versioned before SM_WEBP_SINCE gets a signed URL to the sm file that already exists in the bucket in the original's format (-sm.png / -sm.jpg): no request reaches PHP. stocklist:fotos-afgeleid --maat=sm still creates the WebP files; afterwards the SM_WEBP_SINCE check goes and every thumbnail is WebP.

afgeleidPad() gets a legacyFormat flag; test updated to pin the existing-file URLs.
params.title: Fix 504 on the detail page: thumbnail bridge without on-demand builds
